title: Uyen Ninh eats only white asparagus for 24 hours (German Cooking Challenge with @uyenninh)​
translatedTitle: Uyen Ninh eats only white asparagus for 24 hours (German Cooking Challenge with ‪@uyenninh‬)​
text:
In honor of Germany’s revered tradition of Spargelzeit (White Asparagus Season), @uyenninh dares herself to an endurance cooking challenge: eating only dishes made with the country’s beloved 'White Gold' for a full day. From the classic white asparagus recipe with homemade Hollandaise sauce to the viral asparagus ice cream, this is a journey through German food tradition like you’ve never seen!

White asparagus is a German springtime staple, known for its melt-in-your-mouth texture and delicate flavor. But it’s not easy to master. Watch as Uyen explores how to peel white asparagus properly and reveals the zero-waste kitchen secrets behind a perfect Spargelsuppe (asparagus soup).

Are you brave enough to try these authentic German recipes? Join Uyen as she explores the intersection of Nutrition and Tradition while surviving 24 hours of home cooking with nothing but the ivory of the vegetable garden!

title: What will the cast of One Piece make public vs. keep private? | Unlisted
text:

“It was a dream [back then] to reach a thousand subscribers, like, wow, there are a thousand people paying attention to my content.” Today, German Garmendia has earned YouTube gold with a subscriber count across his channels tallying over 100 million and over 23 billion lifetime views. BILLION. That’s the entire population of this earth watching his videos three times over. Even Guiness World Records has taken note of this champion, crowning him with the title of “Most subscribers for a non-English language gaming channel on YouTube (May, 2025)”. Yet somehow this charming gamer is still as down to earth as the day he started, and is still humbled at the recognition. “When you see someone’s face light up when they see you, that’s why I’m still motivated to do this.”
